turns.userText:
Extend the provided collective codebase into a reservation and schedule compiler.
Work in /workspace using the offline Python 3.11.14 environment.
Read /workspace/PROTOCOL.md for the complete version

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && cat instruction.md SOURCES.md public_check.py && ls -la examples submission vendor tmp

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && wc -l PROTOCOL.md && cat submission/main.py submission/service.py submission/wire.py && cat examples/requests.jsonl examples/answers.jsonl

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && head -60 submission/pipeline_allgather.py && echo ==== && head -40 submission/topologies.py

records.text: Let me look at the remaining legacy code and then start building.

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && wc -l submission/*.py && python3 -c "import sys; print(sys.version)" && ls -la /workspace/vendor && python3 -c "

records.text: Now let me write the planner (feasibility check + plan compiler):
The naive switch-elimination greedy is fragile. Let me redesign phase 1 as a demand-driven (cutting-plane) path reservation, which handled the failing case by h

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -i 's/from planner import compile_plan, deficient_cut, cut_value/from planner import compile_plan, deficient_cut/' tmp/t1.py && timeout 900

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -i 's/rnd.Random(seed+99).randint(60,99)/random.Random(seed+99).randint(60,99)/' tmp/t4.py && timeout 1800 python3 tmp/t4.py 80 2>&1 | tail

records.text: The cutting-plane needs deficit-limited sinks and retry diversity. Let me restructure phase 1:

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls submission/ && find . -name "__pycache__" -type d && rm -rf submission/__pycache__ tmp/__pycache__ && timeout 900 python3 -B tmp/t1.py 2>&1|

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && timeout 1200 python3 -B tmp/t2.py 2000 2>&1 | tail -5 && timeout 1800 python3 -B tmp/t4.py 100 2>&1 | tail -14

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && timeout 1800 python3 -B tmp/t5.py 25 max,rand 2>&1 | tail -45

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && timeout 3000 python3 -B tmp/t5.py 60 max,allpart,fewpart,rand 2>&1 | grep -E "bad|SLOW|EXC|INVALID|SIZE|DENIED" | tail -20

records.text: Now the service layer. Let me write the schema validation and controller:

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -i "s/'samples':\[\[0,\[9,9\]\]\]}/'samples':[[0,[2,2]]]}/" tmp/svc_test2.py && timeout 600 python3 -B tmp/svc_test2.py 2>&1 | tail -5

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && grep -n "'id'" tmp/fuzz2.py | head -5 && grep -n "CONFLICT\|unexpected status" tmp/fuzz2.py | head
